description: This is a JUnit test class for testing the DatabaseUpdater class in the OpenMRS project. It contains unit tests verifying methods related to database updates, including validation for changelog files, exception handling, and integration with Liquibase provider.

classes.name: DatabaseUpdaterTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing DatabaseUpdater methods.

methods.name: updatesRequired_shouldAlwaysHaveAValidUpdateToLatestFile
methods.description: Tests that the updatesRequired method does not throw an exception and can find the changelog file.

methods.name: shouldRejectNullAsChangelog
methods.description: Verifies that passing null to executeChangelog throws IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: shouldRejectNullAsChangelogFilenames
methods.description: Ensures getUnrunDatabaseChanges throws an exception when passed null.

methods.name: shouldRejectEmptyArrayAsChangelogFilenames
methods.description: Ensures getUnrunDatabaseChanges throws an exception when passed an empty array.

methods.name: shouldReturnInjectedLiquibaseProvider
methods.description: Verifies that getLiquibase returns the liquibase provider injected via setLiquibaseProvider.

methods.name: shouldExecuteLiquibaseFileRelativeToApplicationDataDirectory
methods.description: Tests executing a changelog file relative to the application data directory.

methods.name: copyResourcesToApplicationDataDirectory
methods.description: Helper method to copy resource files needed for tests into the application data directory.
